newsitem.title: USA: CMG sells stake in TeleT for cash, stock.
newsitem.headline: CMG sells stake in TeleT for cash, stock.

text.p: CMG Information Services Inc said Thursday it had sold its equity interest in TeleT Communications LLC to Premiere Technologies Inc in a cash-and-stock transaction that carries a pre-tax gain of $7.5 million.

CMG, which acquired its equity interest in TeleT Communications in April, received $500,000 in cash and 320,833 shares of Premiere stock as part of the deal. It had owned a 46 percent stake in the company prior to the transaction.
At the time of the sale, CMG had invested about $750,000 in TeleT, the company said. It said the deal represented a return on its investment of about 10 times in six months.
TeleT Communications provides products and services designed to combine the simple use of the telephone with the flexibility of the Internet.
CMG is a direct-marketing services company.
